studies.name: Section ribs
studies.mechanism: Fixed, finite section faces derived from the original triangles · independent depth and shadow raster · matte material pigments. studies.name: Prismatic exposure
studies.mechanism: Three positive contributions from the same captured view · linear-light bilinear sampling · one normalization over valid source coverage. Illustrative prism-like exposure, not calibrated glass or new viewpoints; peripheral copies clip at the image boundary. Object and tone selections keep the original image masks.

studies.name: Pixel sorting
studies.mechanism: Source-brightness intervals · fixed 72-pixel cap · stable color-record permutation · whole-span activation by normalized disorder. Coverage counts sortable spans, not image area. Shared strength 15/60/95% maps to coverage 0/60/100%. The scene geometry and original mixer masks stay fixed while depicted colors can cross object boundaries.

studies.name: Pixel clusters
studies.mechanism: Fixed 720-pixel source → 120 × 120 logical cells · adaptive feature regions · joint 24-color palette refinement · exact 6× enlargement. Depicted edges can move within the logical grid; original scene geometry, mixer masks and recipes remain. This is an automatic interpretation, not handcrafted pixel art or guaranteed topology.

studies.name: Finite lenses
studies.mechanism: One finite image plane · two Snell crossings per sphere · polarization-path Fresnel transmission · fixed 16 × 16 pixel sampling. Primary transmitted paths only; reflected paths are omitted and picture misses are black. The original scene and mixer masks stay fixed. This is an image-plane depiction, not a complete water simulation.

studies.name: Chromatic shadows
studies.mechanism: Independent triangle-traced key/fill visibility · current shell openings and caster policy · fixed four-state palette · source-luminance modulation. False-color illustration, not colored relighting. Material hue is replaced; directions, geometry and mixer masks stay fixed. Binary pixel-center queries omit penumbrae and refracted paths.
studies.note: Excluded; fixed 720 capture and 20-mesh admission. Needs actual triangles, source depths, worldFromClip and light directions for two visibility fields.

studies.name: Single cutaway
studies.mechanism: Separate source-solid ray intervals clipped by one fixed world plane · uncapped open and perforated surfaces · fresh key shadows · geometric face normals and matte object pigments. Red is section ink, not an inferred interior material. Original objects stay in place; this numerical rendering proxy does not preserve their complete visible shapes or native material optics. Mixer masks remain anchored to the original image.
studies.note: Excluded; source-admitted common-plane solids/open-sheet proxy. Needs actual closed/open topology, camera/light, new shadow visibility and pigment data.

studies.name: Wholetoning
studies.mechanism: Owner-aware tonal regions · fixed connected-block search · black and white fills. Tiny regions affect feature grouping, and reflective surfaces can form noisy bands. A bounded local search without an optimum or topology guarantee; visible owner IDs do not describe hidden backgrounds.
studies.note: Excluded; fixed search work budget fails on many small shapes. Adapt bounded region solver without replacing mechanism.

studies.name: Tone illustration
studies.mechanism: Normalized native normals · signed shared-key incidence · fixed Figure 7 pigment endpoints · unchanged Clean cel lines and bright-metal marker. Positive-facing warm is an explicit convention. Floor shadows remain; body shadows, AO and reflective identity are mostly flattened. The metal marker can darken pixels, and a reserved-dark/white hierarchy is not guaranteed.
studies.note: Shared Clean-cel fields lack real creases and metallic marker metadata.

studies.name: Triangle stack
studies.mechanism: Fixed 144-pixel source-RGB fit · up to 96 ordered triangles · 50% source-over opacity · analytic candidate colors. Bounded local search without an optimum or topology guarantee. The ring loop, reflective sphere and small plant features can lose their identities.

studies.name: Directional color
studies.mechanism: Fixed 720-pixel captured image · three unquantized passes · eight polynomial sectors with a 9-pixel base radius · local image directions guide the sectors. This is color abstraction, not physical paint, semantic understanding, guaranteed topology or material preservation.
studies.note: Excluded for latency (~7 s), not unavailable mathematics. Keep real three-pass abstraction; worker/cancel/performance validation needed.

studies.name: Interior lattice
studies.mechanism: Certified finite prisms inside the original triangle-defined solids · separate depth and own-shadow raster · fixed matte object pigments. Bars retreat from the skin; silhouette, topology and self-support are not preserved or promised. True mesh openings remain; shader-only material holes, textures, reflections and transmission are ignored, including on retained original surfaces. Partial and object-scoped mixes use the original-image masks and retain lower imagery. Scene camera, light and pigments remain inputs; seed and shared treatment strength do not change this fixed study.
studies.note: Excluded; fixed source signatures + 1,503 precomputed bars. Requires actual-scene interior bar generation and visibility, not reuse of Garden bake.
